scope: Internal team inventory of explicit named artifacts only. This is not authorization to publish assets, a copy of those assets, or a complete portable runtime bundle.

inspection.note: Only named file bytes were hashed; selected JSON metadata and runtime source were read. The Sites path was existence-checked without reading its contents.

operational_runtime.application: OperationalRecommender reads the selected temperature from probability_report.json and passes it to OperationalPredictor. The predictor averages seed probability arrays, then applies normalized log-probability temperature scaling. Its direct-constructor default of 1.0 is not a substitute for the saved calibration.
operational_runtime.selection_note: selection.json is retained as selection provenance. Runtime uses report.selection; resolve_selected_runs accepts legacy Windows path spellings by extracting run names and supports an explicit runs_dir. Preserve original evidence bytes.

additional_required_for_full_recommender.needed_for: Empirical baseline probabilities and comparison costs

operational_runtime.additional_limits: Compatible source/dependencies and platform-specific torch installation remain required. Calibration fitting, probability re-evaluation or policy re-evaluation need separate holdout arrays/metadata and nuisance artifacts. No stored model or calibration was executed or re-estimated here.
